data.narrative:
Terranova is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date, led by founder Laurence Allen. The broader robotics and manufacturing sector comprises nine private peers and one public comparable (277810.KQ), including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The stage-progression approach, calibrated to typical seed-to-next-stage advancement multiples, applies a 2.5x step-up to the $7M total raised as a proxy baseline, yielding an implied valuation of $18M. A peer-median approach was not feasible: while ten robotics and manufacturing peers exist, no subset of three or more companies satisfied simultaneous filters for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier, precluding reliable comparables-based triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, centered on $18M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method and reflects typical seed-stage step-up progression rather than market-derived peer pricing. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparable data, which would strengthen confidence in the median estimate. Additional validation would require either expanded peer coverage in the robotics sector or disclosure of recent round terms from comparable seed-stage financings.
